name: SCL: Error Alerts (email on any job failure)

meta.instructions: Central error handler for every SCL production job. Starts with an Error Trigger: n8n runs this workflow automatically whenever ANOTHER workflow that names this one as its 'Error Workflow' fails. To wire it up: in each production flow (888/940/943/850/856-810), open Workflow Settings -> Error Workflow -> select 'SCL: Error Alerts'. Then any real failure emails the recipient with the workflow name, the failed step, the error message, and a link to the execution for debugging. IMPORTANT re false positives: n8n's Error Trigger fires ONLY on an actual execution failure -- NOT on successful runs, IF-branch stops, dedupe skips (already-sent), or empty-data no-ops -- so 'nothing to send' never pages anyone. For transient blips (a momentary API timeout), set retries on the risky node (node Settings -> Retry On Fail, e.g. 2 retries) so it self-heals before counting as a failure. SETUP NEEDED before this works: (1) create an SMTP credential in n8n (any provider) and select it on 'Send Alert Email'; (2) fromEmail/toEmail are set to help@goodmove.xyz (alerts land in the help inbox); adjust recipients if needed. Uses the Send Email (SMTP) node -- swap for the Gmail node if you prefer Gmail OAuth over SMTP.
